problem_text:
A construction project requires 9 specialized tasks to be completed by 9 different teams.

Each task involves a sequence of work phases represented as pairs (Team, Duration),
where each pair specifies the team responsible for the phase and the number of days it will take.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the work phases must be completed.

Task details:
* T1 requires the sequence: (Team5, 7) → (Team3, 7) → (Team7, 7) → (Team2, 1) → (Team4, 3) → (Team6, 10) → (Team1, 5) → (Team8, 5) → (Team9, 1)
* T2 requires the sequence: (Team4, 4) → (Team5, 10) → (Team9, 10) → (Team7, 1) → (Team1, 2) → (Team3, 6) → (Team8, 8) → (Team2, 4) → (Team6, 5)
* T3 requires the sequence: (Team5, 8) → (Team2, 9) → (Team7, 7) → (Team1, 9) → (Team6, 8) → (Team4, 3) → (Team9, 3) → (Team8, 1) → (Team3, 9)
* T4 requires the sequence: (Team8, 10) → (Team2, 4) → (Team7, 8) → (Team4, 7) → (Team3, 1) → (Team9, 3) → (Team1, 5) → (Team6, 5) → (Team5, 9)
* T5 requires the sequence: (Team5, 8) → (Team7, 9) → (Team8, 6) → (Team9, 8) → (Team1, 10) → (Team4, 2) → (Team6, 5) → (Team2, 4) → (Team3, 7)
* T6 requires the sequence: (Team8, 10) → (Team6, 4) → (Team4, 10) → (Team9, 3) → (Team2, 9) → (Team7, 5) → (Team5, 2) → (Team1, 3) → (Team3, 1)
* T7 requires the sequence: (Team9, 6) → (Team8, 5) → (Team7, 7) → (Team5, 1) → (Team4, 1) → (Team3, 1) → (Team1, 4) → (Team6, 7) → (Team2, 2)
* T8 requires the sequence: (Team1, 8) → (Team7, 10) → (Team4, 1) → (Team5, 2) → (Team2, 1) → (Team9, 5) → (Team6, 3) → (Team8, 8) → (Team3, 3)
* T9 requires the sequence: (Team4, 6) → (Team9, 3) → (Team6, 2) → (Team2, 1) → (Team5, 10) → (Team1, 1) → (Team8, 1) → (Team7, 4) → (Team3, 7)

Each work phase must be completed without interruption once it begins,
and each team can only work on one phase at a time.
The objective is to determine the schedule for all work phases across the teams
so that the total project duration (i.e., the completion time of all tasks) is minimized.
